rule.stable: If both source-adjusted and source_citation-adjusted R_family remain >=0.10 and neither family-context/source-concentration association has |rho| >=0.30 with permutation p<0.05, close BIEN empirical analyses. Add the audit as a Supplement sensitivity and retain 'modest recurring family context' language.
rule.compromised: If either adjusted R_family <0.10 OR a predeclared source-concentration association has |rho| >=0.30 with permutation p<0.05, close BIEN empirical analyses anyway but weaken interpretation to 'family-correlated context'; explicitly state that provenance composition is a plausible contributor.
rule.mixed: If source and source_citation diagnostics disagree, report both and use the more cautious 'family-correlated context' wording.

prohibited_after_result: No exclusion of high-concentration families or sources.
publication_consequence: This sensitivity changes wording/limitations only; it does not alter the prospective portability result or reopen system selection.
